about_the_game:
🚀 Welcome to the Next Evolution of Starship Command – Pixel Starships 2!

From the creators of the original galaxy-wide hit, Pixel Starships, comes a bold new chapter in starship strategy, base-building, and multiplayer warfare — rebuilt from the ground up with stunning new visuals, deeper systems, and a thriving living universe.

🛠️ Build. Command. Conquer.
Design every room of your massive starship, manage your crew, and engage in tactical real-time battles across a persistent online galaxy. Whether you’re chasing fame, fortune, or total domination, every decision matters in your journey across the stars.

🧪 What’s in the Demo?

Get a hands-on first look at Pixel Starships 2’s next-gen features:

  • 🚀 Starship Construction: Experience the early stages of ship-building with new modular designs and improved controls.

  • ⚔️ PvE & PvP Battles: Test your command skills in skirmishes against AI captains or challenge other demo players in real-time PvP.

  • 👩‍🚀 Crew Management: Recruit, train, and equip a diverse crew, each with unique roles and backstories.

  • 🌌 Early Missions: Embark on a slice of the story campaign and explore the shifting politics and factions of the galaxy.

🌟 What’s New in Pixel Starships 2?

  • Fully remastered in a new 3D engine while keeping the charm of pixel aesthetics

  • Expanded galaxy with planets, mining, trade routes, and diplomacy

  • Faction loyalty systems and epic galactic wars

  • A fully customizable AI system for automating ship behavior

  • New narrative arcs, alien species, and tech trees

⚠️ Wishlist now and follow us to stay updated on our journey to launch!
Join the community and shape the future of Pixel Starships 2. Your feedback during Steam Next Fest helps chart our course!
